_doc: Pin hotspot offsets in inches relative to PlacePart origin (rot=0, mirror=0). Wire tip = origin + offset. After SetRotation, recompute or re-measure.

0._note: PlaceGround: hotspot is typically place_xy + (0.1, 0). Wire into hotspot from above (rot=0).

crash_avoid: Never source large multi-proc scripts into Capture
One Tcl statement per socket send (batch tool still sends separately)
Avoid bulk DeletePartInst; delete one object at a time
Avoid SetLocation on globals (grounds) — delete+PlaceGround instead, or fix in UI
Avoid PlacePart on marker.etc / BringToFront / Edit Select All Delete via Tcl
Fairchild 2N7000 property edits have crashed — prefer MbreakN + MODEL
Always append newline to each command
